variables.where: {{ (area_name(trigger.entity_id) ~ ' corner (measured)') if 'corner' in trigger.entity_id else (area_name('sensor.climate_temp_' ~ room) or area_name(trigger.entity_id) or room) }}

data.message: The coldest wall surface has been near {{ trigger.to_state.state }} % humidity for 6 hours; mould grows above 80 %. Air it wide open for 5 minutes, keep it warm tonight, and keep furniture off the outside walls.
data.title: Mould risk: {{ where }}

conditions.value_template: {{ trigger.from_state is not none and trigger.from_state.state not in ['unavailable', 'unknown'] }}

description: A room's Mould Indicator (estimated humidity at its coldest wall surface) above 80 % for 6 hours: the level and duration at which mould grows. A push to Vadim. A return from unavailable does not count as a crossing. 2026-11-24: the kid 1 room corner probe pushes on its own measured humidity too.
